name: sidecar-kilo-lifecycle
//: Present so `node` treats sidecar-lifecycle.js as ESM when the behavioral equivalence test drives it directly. Only sidecar-lifecycle.js is ever installed beside a user's Kilo; this file is a build-time detail of the repo and is not part of the asset. Kilo itself does not need it: its loader imports the file by a file:// URL and its own bundler treats a bare .js plugin as a module.
